findings.evidence: renameBudgetCommit renames only shas in `rewritten`, i.e. commits this landing re-applies. 7e02778 changed budget.json's commit line 8d27ab1 -> 72c0152. A held commit that re-records the budget (a pnpm-lock.yaml change) edits the same line from 8d27ab1, so its cherry-pick conflicts on that line. check-budget's new ancestry check (check-budget.mjs:279-288) runs in the staged ladder (precommit.mjs:275), so held stacks not yet rebased onto 7e02778 now fail their own staged ladder, because 8d27ab1 is not on their history.
findings.problem: Expected and correct behaviour, but it will surface in the landing batches as a conflict or a red staged ladder that looks like a land.mjs bug, and the tempting fix (hand-editing the commit value, which ADR-0205 leaves unbound by review) is exactly the weak spot ADR-0205 names.
findings.suggestion: Landing note: rebase held stacks onto 7e02778 before working on them; for any held commit touching .harness/budget.json, resolve by re-recording (check-budget --record --cold-pending) on the rebased parent, not by editing the commit value, and get the re-record reviewed. No row unless it happens.
